title.zh: 卷十四 本紀第十四: 聖宗五
title.raw: 卷十四 本紀第十四: 聖宗五 Volume 14 Annals 14: Shengzong 5

sentences.zh: 聖宗五

translations.literal: Shengzong, Part Five
translations.idiomatic: Shengzong, Part Five

sentences.zh: 十八年春正月，還次南京，賞有功將士，罰不用命者。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, returned and halted at Nanjing, rewarded meritorious officers and soldiers, punished those who disobeyed orders.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Tonghe, in the first spring month the court returned to Nanjing, rewarded officers and soldiers who had distinguished themselves, and punished those who had disobeyed orders.

sentences.zh: 詔諸軍各還本道，二月，幸延芳澱。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the various armies each to return to their original circuits; in the second month, favored and visited Yanfang Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered all armies to return to their home circuits, and in the second month the court went to Yanfang Marsh.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未，駐蹕於清泉澱。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on jiwei day, imperial halt at Qingquan Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day of the fourth summer month the court encamped at Qingquan Marsh.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，清暑炭山。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dingyou day, summer coolness at Coal Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Coal Mountain.

sentences.zh: 六月，阻卜叛酋鶻碾之弟鐵剌不率部眾來附，鶻碾無所歸，遂降，詔誅之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Zubu rebel chieftain Guinian's younger brother Tielabu led his tribes to come and attach; Guinian had nowhere to go, then surrendered; an edict ordered his execution.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Zubu rebel chieftain Guinian's brother Tielabu submitted with his followers; with nowhere to go Guinian surrendered, and an edict ordered his execution.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，駐蹕於湯泉。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, imperial halt at Tangquan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court encamped at Tangquan.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥朔，駐蹕黑河。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yihai new moon, imperial halt at Heihe.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai new moon of the ninth month the court encamped at Heihe.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲戌朔，授西平王李繼遷子德昭朔方軍節度使。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, on jiaxu new moon, granted Western Peace King Li Jiqian's son Dezhao as Shuofang Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu new moon of the eleventh winter month Li Jiqian's son Dezhao was appointed military commissioner of the Shuofang Army.

sentences.zh: 十二月，回鶻來貢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the Uyghur came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Uyghur came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 是年，放進士南承保等三人及第。

translations.literal: That year, jinshi Nan Baoshou and three others were passed and granted degree.
translations.idiomatic: That year Nan Baoshou and two others passed the examinations.

sentences.zh: 十九年春正月辛巳，以祗候郎君班詳穩觀音為奚六部大王。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on xinsi day, appointed zhihou langjun class xiangwen Guanyin as King of the Six Xi Divisions.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Tonghe, on xinsi day of the first spring month, zhihou langjun xiangwen Guanyin was appointed king of the Six Xi Divisions.

sentences.zh: 甲申，回鶻進梵僧名醫。

translations.literal: On jiashen day the Uyghur presented Buddhist monks and famous physicians.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Uyghur presented Buddhist monks and renowned physicians.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，夏國遣李文貴來貢。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yihai day, Xia State dispatched Li Wengui to come with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day of the third month Western Xia sent Li Wengui with tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，西南面招討司奏党項捷。

translations.literal: On yiyou day the Southwestern Pacification Commission reported Tangut victory.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Southwestern Pacification Commission reported a victory over the Tangut.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，皇后蕭氏以罪降為貴妃。

translations.literal: On renchen day Empress Xiao was demoted to noble consort because of crime.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Empress Xiao was demoted to noble consort on account of misconduct.

sentences.zh: 賜大丞相韓德讓名德昌。

translations.literal: Granted Grand Chancellor Han Derang the name Dechang.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Chancellor Han Derang was granted the name Dechang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，幸吳國王隆祐第視疾。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on yisi day, favored and visited Prince of Wu Longyou's residence to see illness.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day of the fourth summer month the Emperor visited Prince of Wu Longyou's residence to inquire after his illness.

sentences.zh: 丙午，問安皇太后。

translations.literal: On bingwu day inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Emperor inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，清暑炭山。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on guiyou day, summer coolness at Coal Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Coal Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，冊蕭氏為齊天皇后。

translations.literal: On bingxu day enfeoffed Xiao as Qitian Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Xiao was invested as Empress Qitian.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以千拽剌詳穩耶律王奴為乙室大王。

translations.literal: On gengyin day appointed qianzhuaila xiangwen Yelü Wangnu as Prince of Yishi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day qianzhuaila xiangwen Yelü Wangnu was appointed Prince of Yishi.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以青牛白馬祭天地。

translations.literal: On xinmao day used green ox and white horse to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the court sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳，以所俘宋將康昭裔為昭順軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yisi day, made captured Song general Kang Zhaoyi Zhao Shun Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day of the sixth month captured Song general Kang Zhaoyi was appointed military commissioner of the Zhaoshun Army.

sentences.zh: 戊午，夏國奏下宋恒、環、慶等三州，賜詔褒之。

translations.literal: On wuwu day Xia State memorialized capturing Song Heng, Huan, Qing and three other prefectures; granted edict to praise them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Western Xia reported the capture of Song's Heng, Huan, Qing, and other prefectures, and an edict was issued to commend them.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙戌，以東京統軍使耶律奴瓜為南府宰相。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on bingxu day, made Eastern Capital army commander Yelü Nugua Southern Chancellery Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day in the seventh autumn month Eastern Capital army commander Yelü Nugua was appointed Southern Chancellery chancellor.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，達盧骨部來貢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengxu day, the Dalugu tribe came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day of the eighth month the Dalugu tribe came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳朔，問安皇太后。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jisi new moon, inquired after Empress Dowager's health.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi new moon of the ninth month the Emperor inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.

sentences.zh: 戊子，駐蹕昌平。

translations.literal: On wuzi day imperial halt at Changping.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the court encamped at Changping.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，西南面招討司奏討吐谷渾捷。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Southwestern Pacification Commission reported victory attacking Tuyuhun.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Southwestern Pacification Commission reported a victory over the Tuyuhun.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，幸南京。

translations.literal: On xinmao day favorably visited Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the court visited Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥，南伐。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on jihai day, southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day of the tenth winter month a southern campaign was launched.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，次鹽溝。

translations.literal: On renyin day halted at Yanyan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the army halted at Yanyan Pass.

sentences.zh: 徙封吳國王隆祐為楚國王，留守京師。

translations.literal: Transferred enfeoffment of Prince of Wu Longyou to Prince of Chu, remaining to guard the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Wu Longyou was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Chu and left to guard the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁未，梁國王隆慶統先鋒軍以進。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Prince of Liang Longqing commanded vanguard army to advance.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Prince of Liang Longqing led the vanguard army forward.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，射鬼箭。

translations.literal: On xinhai day shot ghost arrows.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day ghost arrows were shot.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以青牛白馬祭天地。

translations.literal: On renzi day used green ox and white horse to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the court sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遼軍與宋兵戰於遂城，敗之。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Liao army battled Song troops at Suicheng, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Liao forces defeated Song troops at Suicheng.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以黑白羊祭天地。

translations.literal: On gengshen day used black and white sheep to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the court sacrificed black and white sheep to heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，次滿城，以泥淖班師。

translations.literal: On bingyin day halted at Mancheng, because of mud and mire withdrew army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the army halted at Mancheng and, bogged down in mud, withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，射鬼箭。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengwu day, shot ghost arrows.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day of the eleventh month ghost arrows were shot.

sentences.zh: 丙子，宋兵出淤口、益津關來侵，偵候謀窪、虞人招古擊敗之。

translations.literal: On bingzi day Song troops came out of Yukou and Yijin Pass to invade; scout Mouwa and huntsman Zhao Gu defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Song troops attacked through Yukou and Yijin Pass; scouts Mouwa and gamekeeper Zhao Gu drove them back.

sentences.zh: 己卯，觀漁儒門濼。

translations.literal: On jimao day viewed fishing at Rumen Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the court watched fishing at Rumen Marsh.

sentences.zh: 閏月己酉，鼻骨德來貢。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on jiyou day, the Bigud came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day of the intercalary month the Bigud came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己未，減關市稅。

translations.literal: On jiwei day reduced frontier market taxes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day frontier market taxes were reduced.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，免南京、平州租稅。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengchen day, exempted Nanjing and Ping Prefecture rent and taxes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day of the twelfth month rent and taxes at Nanjing and Ping Prefecture were remitted.

sentences.zh: 二十年春正月庚子，如延芳澱。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on gengzi day, went to Yanfang Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of Tonghe, on gengzi day of the first spring month the Emperor went to Yanfang Marsh.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，東方五色虹見。

translations.literal: On guichou day five-colored rainbow appeared in the east.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day a five-colored rainbow appeared in the east.

sentences.zh: 詔安撫西南面向化諸部。

translations.literal: An edict ordered pacifying the various southwestern submitted tribes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the pacification of the submitted tribes of the southwest.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，夏國遣使貢馬、駝。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Xia State dispatched envoys to present horses and camels.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Western Xia sent envoys presenting horses and camels.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，女直宰相夷離底來貢。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Jurchen chancellor Yilidi came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Jurchen chancellor Yilidi came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，女直遣其子來朝。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingchou day, the Jurchen dispatched their son to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingchou day, a Jurchen chieftain sent his son to court.

sentences.zh: 高麗遣使賀伐宋捷。

translations.literal: Goryeo dispatched envoys to congratulate on the victory attacking Song.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo sent envoys congratulating the court on victory over Song.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，遣北府宰相蕭繼遠等南伐。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiayin day, dispatched Northern Chancellery Chancellor Xiao Jiyuan and others on southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day of the third month Northern Chancellery chancellor Xiao Jiyuan and others were sent on a southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，駐蹕鴛鴦濼。

translations.literal: On renxu day imperial halt at Yuanyang Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the court encamped at Yuanyang Marsh.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅朔，文班太保達裏底敗宋兵於梁門。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on bingyin new moon, Civil Class Grand Guardian Dalidi defeated Song troops at Liangmen.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin new moon of the fourth summer month Civil Class grand guardian Dalidi defeated Song troops at Liangmen.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，南京統軍使蕭撻凜破宋軍於泰州。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Nanjing army commander Xiao Talin broke Song army at Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Nanjing army commander Xiao Talin routed Song forces at Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，南征將校獻俘。

translations.literal: On yiyou day southern campaign officers presented captives.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the officers of the southern campaign presented captives.

sentences.zh: 賜爵賞有差。

translations.literal: Granted ranks and rewards in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Titles and rewards were granted according to rank.

sentences.zh: 戊子，鐵驪遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On wuzi day the Iron Li dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the Iron Li sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月乙卯，幸炭山清暑。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yimao day, favored Coal Mountain for summer coolness.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day of the fifth month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

sentences.zh: 六月，夏國遣劉仁勖來告下靈州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Xia State dispatched Liu Renxu to report capturing Ling Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Western Xia sent Liu Renxu to report the capture of Ling Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on jiawu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu new moon of the seventh autumn month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以邢抱樸為南院樞密使。

translations.literal: On dingyou day made Xing Baopu Southern Chancellery Privy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Xing Baopu was appointed southern privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，高麗遣使來貢本國地理圖。

translations.literal: On xinchou day Goryeo dispatched envoys to come with tribute of their country's geographical map.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Goryeo sent envoys presenting a geographical map of their realm.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳朔，謁顯陵，告南伐捷。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guisi new moon, visited Xian Mausoleum, reported southern campaign victory.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi new moon of the ninth month the Emperor visited the Xian Mausoleum and reported the southern victory.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥朔，至自顯陵。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on guihai new moon, returned from Xian Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai new moon of the tenth winter month the court returned from the Xian Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 十二月，奚王府五帳六節度獻七金山土河川地，賜金幣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the Xi princely establishment's five households and six military commissions presented land of Qijin Mountain, Tuh River valley; granted gold and coins.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Xi princely establishment's five households and six divisions offered land along the Qijin Mountains and the Tuh River; gold and coins were granted in return.

sentences.zh: 是歲，南京、平州麥秀兩歧。

translations.literal: That year, Nanjing and Ping Prefecture wheat showed two ears per stalk.
translations.idiomatic: That year wheat with double ears appeared at Nanjing and Ping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 放進士邢祥等六人及第。

translations.literal: Jinshi Xing Xiang and six others were passed and granted degree.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Xiang and five others passed the examinations.

sentences.zh: 二十一年春正月，如鴛鴦濼。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Tonghe, spring, first month, went to Yuanyang Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of Tonghe, in the first spring month the Emperor went to Yuanyang Marsh.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，詔修日曆官毋書細事。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renchen day, an edict ordered calendar officials not to record minor matters.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day of the third month an edict forbade calendar officials from recording trivial events.

sentences.zh: 甲午，朝皇太后。

translations.literal: On jiawu day audience with Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Emperor attended upon the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 戊午，鐵驪來貢。

translations.literal: On wuwu day the Iron Li came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the Iron Li came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，女直遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on yichou day, the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day of the fourth summer month the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，兀惹、渤海、奧裏米、越裏篤、越裏吉等五部遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Wuran, Bohai, Aolimi, Yuelidu, Yueliji and five other divisions dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Wuran, Bohai, Aolimi, Yuelidu, Yueliji, and other tribes sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 是月，耶律奴瓜、蕭撻凜獲宋將王繼忠於望都。

translations.literal: That month, Yelü Nugua, Xiao Talin captured Song general Wang Jizhong at Wangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yelü Nugua and Xiao Talin captured Song general Wang Jizhong at Wangdu.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅朔，清暑炭山。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengyin new moon, summer coolness at Coal Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin new moon of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Coal Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，西平王李繼遷薨，其子德昭遣使來告。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Western Peace King Li Jiqian died; his son Dezhao dispatched envoys to come report.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Western Peace King Li Jiqian died; his son Dezhao sent envoys to announce the death.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，贈繼遷尚書令，遣西上閣門使丁振吊慰。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jimao day, posthumously granted Jiqian Palace Secretary; dispatched Western Upper Gate envoy Ding Zhen to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day of the sixth month Li Jiqian was posthumously made palace secretary, and Western Upper Gate envoy Ding Zhen was sent with condolences.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，党項來貢。

translations.literal: On xinsi day the Tangut came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Tangut came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，阻卜鐵剌裏率諸部來降。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Zubu chief Tieluli led the various tribes to come and surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Zubu chief Tieluli submitted with his tribes.

sentences.zh: 是月，修可敦城。

translations.literal: That month, repaired Kedun city.
translations.idiomatic: That month Kedun city was repaired.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌，阻卜、烏古來貢。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on gengxu day, Zubu, Wugu came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day in the seventh autumn month the Zubu and Wugu came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以奚王府監軍耶律室魯為南院大王。

translations.literal: On jiayin day made Xi princely establishment military inspector Yelü Shilu Southern Chancellery Great King.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Xi princely establishment military inspector Yelü Shilu was appointed southern chancellery great king.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，阻卜鐵剌裏來朝。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yiyou day, Zubu Tieluli came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day of the eighth month Zubu chief Tieluli came to court.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，朝皇太后。

translations.literal: On bingxu day audience with Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Emperor attended upon the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，夏國李德昭遣使來謝吊贈。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jihai day, Xia State Li Dezhao dispatched envoys to come thank for condolences and posthumous gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day of the ninth month Western Xia's Li Dezhao sent envoys thanking the court for condolences and posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，幸女河湯泉，改其名曰松林。

translations.literal: On guichou day favored Nühe Hot Springs, changed its name to Songlin.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the court visited Nühe Hot Springs and renamed them Songlin.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳朔，駐蹕七渡河。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on dingsi new moon, imperial halt at Qiduh River.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi new moon of the tenth winter month the court encamped at Qiduh River.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以楚國王隆祐為西南面招討使。

translations.literal: On wuchen day made Prince of Chu Longyou Southwestern Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Prince of Chu Longyou was appointed Southwestern Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，故於越耶律休哥之子道士奴、高九等謀叛，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renchen day, former Yuyue Yelü Xiuge's son Daoshinu, Gao Jiu and others plotted rebellion, executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day of the eleventh month Daoshinu, son of the late yuyue Yelü Xiuge, and Gao Jiu and others plotted rebellion and were executed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，通括南院部民。

translations.literal: On bingshen day universally registered Southern Chancellery tribal people.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day a universal registration of Southern Chancellery tribal households was ordered.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未，罷三京諸道貢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guiwei day, abolished tribute from the three capitals and various circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day of the twelfth month tribute missions from the three capitals and all circuits were abolished.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月丁亥，如鴛鴦濼。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on dinghai day, went to Yuanyang Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year of Tonghe, on dinghai day of the first spring month the Emperor went to Yuanyang Marsh.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯朔，女直遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yimao new moon, the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao new moon of the second month the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，南院樞密使邢抱樸薨，輟朝三日。

translations.literal: On bingyin day Southern Chancellery Privy Commissioner Xing Baopu died; court mourning halted three days.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day southern privy commissioner Xing Baopu died, and court was suspended for three days.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，罷番部賀千齡節及冬至、重五貢。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jichou day, abolished tribal congratulations for Thousand Age Festival and Winter Solstice, Double Fifth tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day of the third month tribal tribute missions for the Thousand Age Festival, the winter solstice, and the Double Fifth were abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙未，西夏李德昭遣使上繼遷遺物。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Western Xia Li Dezhao dispatched envoys to present Jiqian's legacy possessions.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Western Xia's Li Dezhao sent envoys presenting Li Jiqian's bequeathed possessions.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，朝皇太后。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on dingmao day, audience with Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day of the fourth summer month the Emperor attended upon the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 五月，清暑炭山。

translations.literal: Fifth month, summered for coolness at Coal Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，以可敦城為鎮州，軍曰建安。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on wuwu day Kedun City was made Zhen Prefecture and its army called Jian'an.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day of the sixth month Kedun City was made Zhen Prefecture and its garrison named Jian'an Army.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，遣使封夏國李德昭為西平王。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiashen day envoys were dispatched to invest Li Dezhao of Western Xia as King of Xiping.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day of the seventh autumn month envoys were sent to invest Li Dezhao of Western Xia as King of Xiping.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，兀惹、蒲奴裏、剖阿裏、越裏篤、奧裏米等部來貢。

translations.literal: On dinghai day the Wunai, Punuli, Po'ali, Yuelidu, Aolimi, and other tribes came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Wunai, Punuli, Po'ali, Yuelidu, Aolimi, and other tribes came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰，党項來貢。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on bingchen day the Tangut came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day of the eighth month the Tangut came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚申，阻卜酋鐵剌裏來朝。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Zubu chief Tielili came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Zubu chief Tielili came to court.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，鐵剌裏求婚，不許。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Tielili requested marriage; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Tielili requested marriage, and the request was refused.

sentences.zh: 丙子，駐蹕犬牙山。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the court halted at Quanya Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the court halted at Quanya Mountain.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，以南伐諭高麗。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jichou day Goryeo was notified of the southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day of the ninth month Goryeo was notified of the southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 丙午，幸南京。

translations.literal: On bingwu day the court visited Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the court visited Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 女直遣使獻所獲烏昭慶妻子。

translations.literal: The Jurchen sent envoys presenting the wife and children of Wu Zhaoqing, whom they had captured.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchen sent envoys presenting the wife and children of the captured Wu Zhaoqing.

sentences.zh: 丁未，致祭於太宗皇帝廟。

translations.literal: On dingwei day sacrifice was performed at Emperor Taizong's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day sacrifice was performed at Emperor Taizong's temple.

sentences.zh: 以北院大王磨魯古、太尉老君奴監北、南王府兵。

translations.literal: Northern Court Great King Malugu and Grand Commandant Laojunnu were put in charge of the Northern and Southern Princely House troops.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Court Great King Malugu and Grand Commandant Laojunnu were put in charge of the Northern and Southern Princely House troops.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，命楚國王隆祐留守京師。

translations.literal: On gengxu day King of Chu Longyou was ordered to remain at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day King of Chu Longyou was ordered to remain at the capital.

sentences.zh: 閏月己未，南伐。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on jiwei day the southern campaign began.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day of the intercalary month the southern campaign began.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，次固安。

translations.literal: On guihai day the court halted at Gu'an.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the court halted at Gu'an.

sentences.zh: 以所獲諜者射鬼箭。

translations.literal: A captured spy was used to shoot ghost arrows.
translations.idiomatic: A captured spy was used in the ghost-arrow rite.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以青牛白馬祭天地。

translations.literal: On jiazi day black ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day black ox and white horse were sacrificed to heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，遼師與宋兵戰於唐興，大破之。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the Liao army fought Song forces at Tangxing and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Liao army fought Song forces at Tangxing and inflicted a great defeat.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，蕭撻凜與宋軍戰於遂城，敗之。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Xiao Talin fought the Song army at Suicheng and defeated it.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Xiao Talin fought the Song army at Suicheng and defeated it.

sentences.zh: 庚午，軍於望都。

translations.literal: On gengwu day the army encamped at Wangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the army encamped at Wangdu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉，以黑白羊祭天地。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yiyou day black and white sheep were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day of the tenth winter month black and white sheep were sacrificed to heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，攻瀛州，不克。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Ying Prefecture was attacked but not taken.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Ying Prefecture was attacked but not taken.

sentences.zh: 甲午，下祁州，賚降兵以酒脯。

translations.literal: On jiawu day Qizhou was taken, and surrendering troops were rewarded with wine and dried meat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Qizhou was taken, and surrendering troops were rewarded with wine and dried meat.

sentences.zh: 祭天地。

translations.literal: Sacrifice was performed to heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice was performed to heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 己酉，西平王李德昭遣使謝封冊。

translations.literal: On jiyou day King of Xiping Li Dezhao sent envoys thanking the court for the investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day King of Xiping Li Dezhao sent envoys thanking the court for the investiture.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸亥，馬軍都指揮使耶律課裏遇宋兵於洺州，擊退之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on guihai day cavalry commander Yelü Keli encountered Song forces at Ming Prefecture and repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day of the eleventh month cavalry commander Yelü Keli encountered Song forces at Ming Prefecture and repelled them.

sentences.zh: 甲子，東京留守蕭排押獲宋魏府官吏田逢吉、郭守榮、常顯、劉綽等以獻。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Eastern Capital regent Xiao Paiya captured Song officials of Wei prefecture Tian Fengji, Guo Shourong, Chang Xian, Liu Chuo, and others and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Eastern Capital regent Xiao Paiya captured Song officials of Wei prefecture Tian Fengji, Guo Shourong, Chang Xian, Liu Chuo, and others and presented them.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，南院大王善補奏宋遣人遺王繼忠弓矢，密請求和。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Southern Court Great King Shanbu reported that Song had sent bows and arrows to Wang Jizhong and secretly requested peace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Southern Court Great King Shanbu reported that Song had sent bows and arrows to Wang Jizhong and secretly requested peace.

sentences.zh: 詔繼忠與使會，許和。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Wang Jizhong to meet the envoy, and peace was granted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Wang Jizhong to meet the envoy, and peace was granted.

sentences.zh: 庚午，攻破德清軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Deqing Army was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Deqing Army was captured.

sentences.zh: 壬申，次澶淵。

translations.literal: On renshen day the court halted at Chanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the court halted at Chanyuan.

sentences.zh: 蕭撻凜中伏弩死。

translations.literal: Xiao Talin was struck by a hidden crossbow bolt and died.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Talin was struck by a hidden crossbow bolt and died.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，攻破通利軍。

translations.literal: On yihai day Tongli Army was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Tongli Army was captured.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，宋遣崇儀副使曹利用請和，即遣飛龍使韓杞持書報聘。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Song sent Vice Commissioner for Court Ceremonies Cao Liyong seeking peace, and the Flying Dragon Commissioner Han Qi was immediately dispatched with a letter in reply.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Song sent Vice Commissioner for Court Ceremonies Cao Liyong seeking peace, and the Flying Dragon Commissioner Han Qi was immediately sent with a letter in reply.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰朔，日有食之，既。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on the gengchen new moon there was a total solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen new moon of the twelfth month there was a total solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸未，宋復遣曹利用來，以無還地之意，遣監門衛大將軍姚柬之持書往報。

translations.literal: On guiwei day Song again sent Cao Liyong, and because there was no intention to return territory, Supervisory Gate Guard General Yao Shuzhi was dispatched with a letter in reply.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Song again sent Cao Liyong, and because there was no intention to return territory, Supervisory Gate Guard General Yao Shuzhi was sent with a letter in reply.

sentences.zh: 戊子，宋遣李繼昌請和，以太后為叔母，願歲輸銀十萬兩，絹二十萬匹。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Song sent Li Jichang seeking peace, addressing the Empress Dowager as aunt and offering yearly payment of one hundred thousand taels of silver and two hundred thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Song sent Li Jichang seeking peace, addressing the Empress Dowager as aunt and offering yearly payment of one hundred thousand taels of silver and two hundred thousand bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 許之，即遣閤門使丁振持書報聘。

translations.literal: Peace was granted, and Gate Commissioner Ding Zhen was immediately dispatched with a letter in reply.
translations.idiomatic: Peace was granted, and Gate Commissioner Ding Zhen was immediately sent with a letter in reply.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔諸軍解嚴。

translations.literal: On jichou day an edict ordered all armies to stand down.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day an edict ordered all armies to stand down.

sentences.zh: 是月，班師。

translations.literal: That month the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: That month the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 皇太后賜大丞相齊王韓德昌姓耶律，徙王晉。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager granted Grand Chancellor King of Qi Han Dechang the surname Yelü and transferred him to King of Jin.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager granted Grand Chancellor King of Qi Han Dechang the surname Yelü and transferred him to King of Jin.

sentences.zh: 是年，放進士李可封等三人。

translations.literal: That year jinshi Li Kefeng and three others were passed and granted degree.
translations.idiomatic: That year jinshi Li Kefeng and three others passed the examinations.

sentences.zh: 二十三年春正月戊午，還次南京。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, spring, first month, on wuwu day the court returned and halted at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, on wuwu day of the first spring month, the court returned and halted at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大饗將卒，爵賞有差。

translations.literal: On gengshen day a great feast was held for generals and soldiers, and ranks and rewards were granted in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day a great feast was held for generals and soldiers, and ranks and rewards were granted in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，復置榷場於振武軍。

translations.literal: Second month, on bingxu day the border market at Zhenwu Army was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day of the second month the border market at Zhenwu Army was restored.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，夏國遣使告下宋青城。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Western Xia sent envoys reporting the capture of Song's Qingcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Western Xia sent envoys reporting the capture of Song's Qingcheng.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，朝皇太后。

translations.literal: On xinyou day the court had audience with the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the court had audience with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 以惕隱化哥為南院大王，行軍都監老君奴為惕隱。

translations.literal: Tiyin Huage was made Southern Court Great King, and mobile army supervisor Laojunnu was made tiyin.
translations.idiomatic: Tiyin Huage was appointed Southern Court Great King, and mobile army supervisor Laojunnu was appointed tiyin.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，振党項部。

translations.literal: On yichou day the Tangut tribes were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the Tangut tribes were pacified.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，回鶻來貢。

translations.literal: On dingmao day the Uyghur came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Uyghur came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，改易州飛狐招安使為安撫使。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the Feihu recruitment-and-pacification commissioner of Yi Prefecture was changed to pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Feihu recruitment-and-pacification commissioner of Yi Prefecture was changed to pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，女直及阿薩蘭回鶻各遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingxu day the Jurchen and Arsalan Uyghur each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day of the fourth summer month the Jurchen and Arsalan Uyghur each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙未，鐵驪來貢。

translations.literal: On yiwei day the Iron Li came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Iron Li came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己亥，党項來侵。

translations.literal: On jihai day the Tangut invaded.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the Tangut invaded.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申朔，宋遣孫僅等來賀皇太后生辰。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on the wushen new moon Song sent Sun Jin and others to congratulate the Empress Dowager's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen new moon of the fifth month Song sent Sun Jin and others to congratulate the Empress Dowager's birthday.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以金帛賜陣亡將士家。

translations.literal: On yimao day gold and silk were granted to the families of soldiers killed in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day gold and silk were granted to the families of soldiers killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，高麗以與宋和，遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On bingyin day Goryeo, because of peace with Song, sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Goryeo, because of peace with Song, sent envoys to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，清暑炭山。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on renchen day the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day of the sixth month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

sentences.zh: 甲午，阻卜酋鐵剌裏遣使賀與宋和。

translations.literal: On jiawu day Zubu chief Tielili sent envoys congratulating the peace with Song.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Zubu chief Tielili sent envoys congratulating the peace with Song.

sentences.zh: 己亥，達旦國九部遣使來聘。

translations.literal: On jihai day the nine tribes of Dadan state sent envoys on a friendly visit.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the nine tribes of Dadan state sent envoys on a friendly visit.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑，問安皇太后。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on guichou day the court inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day of the seventh autumn month the court inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.

sentences.zh: 戊午，党項來貢。

translations.literal: On wuwu day the Tangut came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the Tangut came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以青牛白馬祭天地。

translations.literal: On xinyou day black ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day black ox and white horse were sacrificed to heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，烏古來貢。

translations.literal: On renxu day the Ugu came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the Ugu came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，女直遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On dingmao day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 阿薩蘭回鶻遣使來請先留使者，皆遣之。

translations.literal: Arsalan Uyghur sent envoys requesting the release of previously detained envoys; all were sent off.
translations.idiomatic: Arsalan Uyghur sent envoys requesting the release of previously detained envoys, and all were sent off.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌，遣太尉阿裏、太傅楊六賀宋主生辰。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jiaxu day Grand Commandant Ali and Grand Tutor Yang Liu were dispatched to congratulate the Song emperor's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the ninth month Grand Commandant Ali and Grand Tutor Yang Liu were sent to congratulate the Song emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子朔，鼻骨德來貢。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on the bingzi new moon the Bigud came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi new moon of the tenth winter month the Bigud came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊子，朝皇太后。

translations.literal: On wuzi day the court had audience with the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the court had audience with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 甲午，駐蹕七渡河。

translations.literal: On jiawu day the court halted at Qidu River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the court halted at Qidu River.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，宋歲幣始至，後為常。

translations.literal: On guimao day Song's yearly tribute first arrived; afterward it became regular.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Song's yearly tribute first arrived; afterward it became regular.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申，上遣太保合住、頒給使韓橁，太后遣太師盆奴、政事舍人高正使宋賀正旦。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on wushen day the Emperor dispatched Grand Preceptor Hezhu and distribution commissioner Han Song, and the Empress Dowager dispatched Grand Preceptor Pannu and Secretariat drafter Gao Zheng to Song to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day of the eleventh month the Emperor sent Grand Preceptor Hezhu and distribution commissioner Han Song, and the Empress Dowager sent Grand Preceptor Pannu and Secretariat drafter Gao Zheng to Song to congratulate the New Year.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，觀漁桑乾河。

translations.literal: On xinhai day the court watched fishing on the Sanggan River.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the court watched fishing on the Sanggan River.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔大丞相耶律德昌出宮籍，屬於橫帳。

translations.literal: On dingsi day an edict ordered Grand Chancellor Yelü Dechang removed from the palace household registry and affiliated with the Horizontal Tents.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day an edict ordered Grand Chancellor Yelü Dechang removed from the palace household registry and affiliated with the Horizontal Tents.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，宋遣周漸等來賀千齡節。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on bingshen day Song sent Zhou Jian and others to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day of the twelfth month Song sent Zhou Jian and others to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，復遣張若谷等來賀正旦。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Song again sent Zhang Ruogu and others to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Song again sent Zhang Ruogu and others to congratulate the New Year.

sentences.zh: 二十四年春正月，如鴛鴦濼。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, spring, first month, the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, in the first spring month, the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬寅朔，幸炭山清暑。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, on the renyin new moon the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin new moon of the fifth summer month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

sentences.zh: 幽皇太妃胡輦於懷州，囚夫人夷懶於南京，餘黨皆生瘞之。

translations.literal: Imperial Consort Hu of You was buried alive at Huaizhou, Lady Yilan was imprisoned at Nanjing, and all remaining conspirators were buried alive.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Consort Hu of You was buried alive at Huaizhou, Lady Yilan was imprisoned at Nanjing, and all remaining conspirators were buried alive.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑朔，南幸。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the xinchou new moon the court made a southern tour.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou new moon of the seventh autumn month the court made a southern tour.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，改南京宮宣教門為元和，外三門為南端，左掖門為萬春，右掖門為千秋。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on bingxu day Nanjing Palace's Xuanjiao Gate was renamed Yuanhe, the outer three gates Nanduan, the left side gate Wanchun, and the right side gate Qianqiu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day of the eighth month Nanjing Palace's Xuanjiao Gate was renamed Yuanhe, the outer three gates Nanduan, the left side gate Wanchun, and the right side gate Qianqiu.

sentences.zh: 是月，沙州敦煌王曹壽遣使進大食國馬及美玉，以對衣、銀器等物賜之。

translations.literal: That month Shazhou Dunhuang King Cao Shou sent envoys presenting Arabian horses and fine jade; paired robes, silver vessels, and other items were granted in return.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shazhou Dunhuang King Cao Shou sent envoys presenting Arabian horses and fine jade, and paired robes, silver vessels, and other items were granted in return.

sentences.zh: 九月，幸南京。

translations.literal: Ninth month, the court visited Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the court visited Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午朔，帝率群臣上皇太后尊號曰睿德神略應運啟化承天皇太后，群臣上皇帝尊號曰至德廣孝昭聖天輔皇帝。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on the gengwu new moon the Emperor led the officials in bestowing on the Empress Dowager the honorific Sage Virtue, Divine Strategy, Responsive Fortune, Initiating Transformation, and Sustaining Heaven Empress Dowager, and the officials bestowed on the Emperor the honorific Utmost Virtue, Broad Filiality, Illustrious Sagacity, Heaven-Assisted Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu new moon of the tenth winter month the Emperor led the officials in bestowing on the Empress Dowager the honorific Sage Virtue, Divine Strategy, Responsive Fortune, Initiating Transformation, and Sustaining Heaven Empress Dowager, and the officials bestowed on the Emperor the honorific Utmost Virtue, Broad Filiality, Illustrious Sagacity, Heaven-Assisted Emperor.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 是年，放進士楊佶等二十三人及第。

translations.literal: That year jinshi Yang Ji and twenty-three others were passed and granted degree.
translations.idiomatic: That year jinshi Yang Ji and twenty-three others passed the examinations.

sentences.zh: 二十五年春正月，建中京。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, spring, first month, the Central Capital was built.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, in the first spring month, the Central Capital was built.

sentences.zh: 二月，如鴛鴦濼。

translations.literal: Second month, the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，清暑炭山。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

sentences.zh: 六月，賜皇太妃胡輦死於幽所。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Imperial Consort Hu was granted death at her place of confinement.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Imperial Consort Hu was granted death at her place of confinement.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，西平王李德昭母薨，遣使吊祭。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renshen day the mother of King of Xiping Li Dezhao died, and envoys were dispatched to mourn and sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day of the seventh autumn month the mother of King of Xiping Li Dezhao died, and envoys were sent to mourn and sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，遣使起復。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day envoys were dispatched to recall him from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day envoys were sent to recall him from mourning.

sentences.zh: 九月，西北路招討使蕭圖玉討阻卜，破之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, Northwestern Road pacification commissioner Xiao Tuyu attacked the Zubu and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Northwestern Road pacification commissioner Xiao Tuyu attacked the Zubu and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，駐蹕中京。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on bingshen day the court halted at the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day of the tenth winter month the court halted at the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，振饒州饑民。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on yiyou day famine victims of Raozhou were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day of the twelfth month famine victims of Raozhou were relieved.

sentences.zh: 二十六年春二月，如長濼。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, spring, second month, the court went to Chang Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, in the second spring month, the court went to Chang Marsh.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯朔，祠木葉山。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on the xinmao new moon sacrifice was performed at Mount Muye.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao new moon of the fourth summer month sacrifice was performed at Mount Muye.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申朔，還上京。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on the gengshen new moon the court returned to the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen new moon of the fifth month the court returned to the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，高麗進龍須草席。

translations.literal: On bingyin day Goryeo presented dragon-whisker grass mats.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Goryeo presented dragon-whisker grass mats.

sentences.zh: 己巳，遣使賀中京成。

translations.literal: On jisi day dispatched envoys to congratulate completion of the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day envoys were sent to congratulate the completion of the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚午，致祭祖、懷二陵。

translations.literal: On gengwu day performed sacrifice at the Zu and Huai mausoleums.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the court offered sacrifice at the Zu and Huai mausoleums.

sentences.zh: 辛未，駐蹕懷州。

translations.literal: On xinwei day imperial halt at Huaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the court encamped at Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，增太祖、太宗、讓國皇帝、世宗謚，仍謚皇太弟李胡曰欽順皇帝。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, augmented posthumous titles of Taizu, Taizong, Emperor Who Yielded the Realm, and Shizong; also posthumously titled Imperial Younger Brother Li Hu Emperor Qinshun.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the posthumous titles of Emperor Taizu, Emperor Taizong, the Emperor Who Yielded the Realm, and Emperor Shizong were augmented; Imperial Younger Brother Li Hu was also posthumously titled Emperor Qinshun.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子朔，幸中京。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuzi new moon, favorably visited the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi new moon of the tenth winter month the court visited the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月，蕭圖玉奏討甘州回鶻，降其王耶剌裏，撫慰而還。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Xiao Tuyu memorialized campaigning against Ganzhou Uighurs, reduced their king Yelali, pacified and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Xiao Tuyu reported a campaign against the Ganzhou Uighurs, subdued their king Yelali, reassured the people, and returned.

sentences.zh: 是年，放進士史克忠等一十三人。

translations.literal: That year, jinshi Shi Kezhong and thirteen others were passed and granted degree.
translations.idiomatic: That year Shi Kezhong and twelve others passed the examinations.

sentences.zh: 二十七年春正月，鉤魚土河。

translations.literal: Twenty-seventh year, spring, first month, hooked fish on the Tu River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, in the first spring month, the court went ice fishing on the Tu River.

sentences.zh: 獵於瑞鹿原。

translations.literal: Hunted at Ruilu Plain.
translations.idiomatic: The court hunted at Ruilu Plain.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌朔，駐蹕中京，營建宮室。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingxu new moon, imperial halt at the Central Capital, constructing palace halls.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon of the fourth summer month the court encamped at the Central Capital and began building palace halls.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，廢霸州處置司。

translations.literal: On gengxu day abolished Bazhou disposition office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Bazhou disposition office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅朔，霖雨，潢、土、斡剌、陰涼四河皆溢，漂沒民舍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiayin new moon, continuous rain; Huang, Tu, Wala, and Yinliang four rivers all overflowed, washing away commoners' dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin new moon of the seventh autumn month heavy rains caused the Huang, Tu, Wala, and Yinliang rivers to overflow and wash away civilian dwellings.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申，北幸。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on jiashen day, northern tour.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day of the eighth month the court made a northern tour.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬子朔，行柴冊禮。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, on renzi new moon, performed firewood-and-script rite.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the eleventh winter month the firewood-and-script rites were performed.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，南幸。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on yiyou day, southern tour.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day of the twelfth month the court made a southern tour.

sentences.zh: 皇太后不豫。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager fell ill.

sentences.zh: 戊子，肆赦。

translations.literal: On wuzi day proclaimed general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，皇太后崩於行宮。

translations.literal: On xinmao day the Empress Dowager died at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Empress Dowager died at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣使報哀於宋、夏、高麗。

translations.literal: On renchen day dispatched envoys to report mourning to Song, Xia, and Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day envoys were sent to announce the mourning to Song, Western Xia, and Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 戊申，如中京。

translations.literal: On wushen day went to the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the court went to the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔免賀千齡節。

translations.literal: On jiyou day an edict canceled congratulations for the Thousand Age Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict canceled observance of the Thousand Age Festival.

sentences.zh: 是歲，御前引試劉二宜等三人。

translations.literal: That year, imperial preliminary examination of Liu Eryi and three others.
translations.idiomatic: That year Liu Eryi and two others passed the imperial preliminary examination.
